skills.name: pacman
skills.title: Pac-Man
skills.description: An arcade jingle, then one eye becomes Pac-Man and eats the other eye's dots, waka by waka. Usually he chomps off the screen; sometimes a ghost chases him off, and sometimes it catches him.
skills.author: D5 skills

skills.name: peekaboo
skills.title: Peekaboo
skills.description: He hides behind his lift with his eyes shut, then drops it, pops his eyes wide open and says Peekaboo! Sometimes he does it twice.
skills.author: D5 skills
